tree.heading: General Authority.—
tree.text: The President may make agreements with interested maritime countries to—

children.text: maintain in the North Atlantic Ocean a service of ice patrol, of study and observation of ice and current conditions, and of assistance to vessels and their crews requiring assistance within the limits of the patrol;
maintain a service of study and observation of ice and current conditions in the waters affecting the set and drift of ice in the North Atlantic Ocean; and

take all practicable steps to ensure the destruction or removal of derelicts in the northern part of the Atlantic Ocean, east of the line drawn from Cape Sable to a point in latitude 34 degrees north, longitude 70 degrees west, if the destruction or removal is necessary.

tree.heading: Payment Between Countries.—
tree.text: The President may include in an agreement under subsection (a) a provision for—

children.text: payment to the United States Government by other countries for their proportionate share of the expense of maintaining the services; or
contribution by the Government for its proportionate share if the agreement provides for another country to maintain the services.

tree.heading: Payments.—
tree.text: Payments received pursuant to subsection (b)(1) shall be credited to the appropriation for operations and support of the Coast Guard.
